findingsFixed: Cordis Proxy cannot invoke private-backed getters; preauthorization flags are immutable own properties while authority retains private state.
An exact opt-in goal_schedule predicate joins Policy/Isolation; it reads current owner/native/budget/frozen acceptance without reserving or mutating them.

A real installed restart exposed native idle/blocked before asynchronous verification finished: step succeeded while verifier was verifying, whole awaiting, zero receipts, but wake had already succeeded.
Delivery now waits for this Agent settlement before disposal, remains bounded by cancellation/deadline, and rechecks current owner and terminal identity.
Only exact achieved whole-receipt plus successful final-run provenance permits the final blocked-to-complete extra revision.
A versioned Host capability rejects older Delivery semantics before schedule and dispatch.
Browser fixture dependencies and initial-notice persistence corrected; current-page diagnostics distinguish fresh contexts from Playwright default-page snapshots.
limits: Actual installer, disk Session restoration, new Host PIDs, fresh browser contexts and real bounded Docker jobs; model and meter remain deterministic fixtures.
One exact persisted-conversation owner route and verifier/background Policy are explicitly configured after installation; default installer is not claimed to provide general autonomous Goals.
Revocation uses an operator seed in a stopped disposable owner ledger and disables fixed-owner Web UI; background services independently deny before Goal dispatch.
Interruption sends SIGINT after a real source job starts; unknown/dispatched work is not replayed after restart. This is not a proof against every abrupt OS or Docker failure.
Held-verifier deadline and owner-revocation tests use a controlled async gate; existing native stop/late-tool tests also pass. No long-term business improvement or real-model billing claim.
A succeeded wake means confirmed bounded lifecycle termination, not business achievement; separate whole-goal receipts establish achievement in the positive scenario.
No actual user-profile activation, external GitHub action, production credentials, image pull, shared daemon restart or package release.
C2C c2c_a941 contains local execution records only; required in-app browser is unavailable and no ChatGPT web review is claimed.
Remaining work packages and production metering/configuration continue; there is no day/week observation waiting gate.
